ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 80% high-intensity (white/off-white) pixels to 20% low-intensity (black/dark-grey) pixels across the visible ventral fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant white central field. Solid black continuous banding along the entire trailing edge and lateral tips. Discrete dark circular and sub-circular spots (mottling) scattered across the white surface, with higher concentrations in the lower-left and lower-right quadrants near the peduncle attachment.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated angle of approximately 42 degrees relative to the horizontal lobe axis.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations across the entire trailing edge boundary. Significant pixel-amplitude variations forming a jagged profile, particularly concentrated on the distal sections of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical sweep with slight convexity in the mid-lobe regions, transitioning to sharp upward curves at the lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular and ring-shaped pixel clusters (dark outer rings with lighter centers) identified on the upper-right lobe. Scattered white circular spots detected within the dark pigmentation of the left lateral tip.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Heavily textured and irregular lateral tips showing signs of historical tissue loss or significant barnacle colonization scars. Distinctive ring-like parasitic or attachment scars on the right lobe surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Significant transient high-intensity pixel noise across the central-vertical axis due to water spray and droplets occluding the fluke surface.
